title: Where the basket goes
description: Each row divides one whole into the same ordered parts, with totals above and shares below.

props.name: data
props.description: Caller-ordered { id, label, values } rows with unique nonempty IDs. values maps each part ID to a finite, nonnegative amount. A row with any unavailable part, or a zero total, keeps its label with a dash and no bar.

props.name: parts
props.description: One to four { id, label, tone? } parts in stacking order, with unique nonempty IDs. Optional tone a–d identifies a part; omitted tones follow the part order.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned heading for the whole being divided. Defaults to Value.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned context beside the heading.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats row totals and tooltip amounts. Shares always read as whole percentages. Defaults to en-US numbers with at most two decimal places.

props.name: animate
props.description: Defaults to true; the parts draw left to right within the chart's draw duration and honor live reduced-motion changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional container classes. The chart fills its parent; narrow containers scroll locally.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible chart title. Arrow keys inspect rows through Recharts.
